menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Imperial caviar €25 and cheeses €20 extra. At tables of more than four, everyone orders the same.

menus.name: Four-course à la carte menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Two starters, a main course and a dessert chosen from the à la carte list.

alsoTry.name: Único
alsoTry.note: An eight-seat private table inside the kitchen with its own set menu and pairing, prepaid when booking.

bookingOpens: Online through the TheFork booking form on the restaurant's website. A confirmation email follows; if it doesn't arrive within 10 minutes, check spam or contact the restaurant.
cancellation: Card details secure the booking; nothing is charged at the time. Free to cancel or change up to 24 hours before. Later cancellations, no-shows and missing guests can be charged €140 per person.
waitlist: When a date is full there's an optional waiting list, which can be joined for more than one date. The restaurant calls if a table comes free through a cancellation.
groups: Groups of seven or more can book online or by email. Groups of more than eight pay €150 per person in advance to confirm. The whole restaurant can be booked for events by email.
dressCode: Smart casual. No hats, flip-flops or sportswear.
